parts.identity: SpeedyBee F405 Mini BLS 35A 20x20 stack (F405 Mini FC, ICM42688P, DPS310 baro, 8 MB flash; BLS 35A Mini V2 ESC, BLHeli_S J-H-40)
parts.mass_note: The maker lists the FC at 9.6 g and the ESC at 7.2 g but the stack at 13.5 g; the parts sum to more than the whole, so the sum (16.8 g) is used until the stack is weighed.

sources.supports: US$64.99 (the page banner still says $59.99); FC 9.6 g, ESC 7.2 g, stack 13.5 g; 32 x 35 x 14.2 mm; 35 A x 4 continuous, 45 A burst (5 s); 20 x 20 mount; 8 MB onboard flash; '4 x UARTs'; UART4 dedicated to Bluetooth, UART5 to ESC telemetry; ESC firmware BLHeli_S J-H-40

uarts_reserved.UART4: dedicated to the on-board Bluetooth module (maker page; INAV target.h)
uarts_reserved.UART5: ESC telemetry, RX only on the ESC connector (maker page; ArduPilot README)

parts.identity: iFlight BLITZ Mini M10 GPS V2 (20x20 mm; u-blox M10, QMC5883L compass)
parts.availability_note: Replaces the Matek M10Q-5883, which Matek marks end-of-life and GetFPV files under /discontinued/. Foxeer M10Q-180 (7.5 g, 18 x 18 x 8 mm) is the fallback, but one retailer marks it discontinued.

sources.supports: carbon fibre thicknesses 1.02, 1.60, 2.01, 3.00, 3.99, 5.00, 8.00 mm; density about 0.06 lb/in^3; minimum hole about 0.125 in; minimum web at least 2x material thickness; fibre orientation not selectable

carbon_plate.density_note: The cutter states about 0.06 lb/in^3, which the build converts to g/cm^3. The 1.5-1.6 g/cm^3 range typical of cured 3K laminate is kept as a sensitivity case.
carbon_plate.modulus_note: One UK plate maker's 3K twill laminate (42 % resin) reports a 55.2 GPa tensile modulus; 40 GPa is used as a pessimistic lower bound.
carbon_plate.laminate: 3K 2x2 twill, woven 0/90 plies through the thickness (the cutter's stock; fibre orientation cannot be selected at this cutter)
carbon_plate.g12_note: Typical in-plane shear modulus and Poisson ratio for woven carbon/epoxy; used only to estimate the bias (45 degree) modulus.

usable_capacity_fraction.why: Land at about 3.7 V/cell under load; common LiPo practice.

avionics_power_w.why: FC + GPS + receiver + camera + VTX at 350 mW output; not measured.

mass_limit_g.why: EU C0 MTOM limit is 'less than 250 g'; FAA recreational registration exception is 'less than 250 grams'.

mass_design_margin_g.why: Kept free under the limit for scale error, glue, heat-shrink and a heavier cell.

min_tw_ratio.why: Lower bound for confident GPS/position-hold flight with wind margin on a 3-inch; racers run 6+.

min_prop_clearance_mm.why: Radial gap from a prop tip to any part that reaches the prop plane; above FDM/CNC tolerance and blade flex.

min_vertical_gap_mm.why: Gap from the top of the prop hub to anything above the prop disc.

max_cg_offset_mm.why: Horizontal CG offset from the thrust centre that the controller trims without visible motor saturation.

tip_mass_extra_g.why: Four M2x6 screws and a prop nut per arm.

regulation_sources.supports: Class C0: MTOM less than 250 g including payload, 19 m/s, 120 m
FAA: registration exception for drones under 250 g flown under the recreational exception

Taiwan Civil Aviation Act Art. 99-10: a drone of 250 g or more maximum take-off weight owned by a natural person, and any drone owned by a government body, school or legal person, must be registered and marked

Art. 99-14 flight rules at every weight: not above 400 ft; not over crowds; not between sunset and sunrise; within visual line of sight with no aid other than corrective lenses; the operator watches the aircraft at all times

Art. 99-13: no flight in prohibited or restricted areas or near airports; local governments may set areas and times (as reported by the 2026-11-14 review; this article was not fetched for this package)

hardware_spec.note: Fastener geometry from ISO 7380 button-head nominal sizes; masses are upper bounds (head modelled as a cylinder). Motor screw length is a choice: thread depth in the F1404 base is not published.

cutter_rules.note: Minimum hole about 0.125 in (3.2 mm); minimum web at least 2x material thickness.
